name: 珲

zh.eyebrow: 一份慢慢生长的个人记录
zh.title: 科研之外，生活之中。
zh.body: 我是珲。在这里记录研究中的问题、生活里的片刻，以及一路做过的东西。先写，再生长。

en.title:
A little research.
A little life.
en.body: I'm Hui. This is a place for questions from research, moments from everyday life, and things I make along the way. Write first. Let it grow.

about.zh:
我想要一个自己的空间，用来放下那些不适合只留在聊天窗口、实验记录或者社交媒体里的东西。

这里有科研记录、生活随笔和作品。不是每个问题都有答案，也不是每段记录都需要结论。
about.en:
I wanted a space of my own for things that don't quite belong in a chat window, an experiment log, or a social feed.

Here you'll find research notes, fragments of everyday life, and things I make. Not every question needs an answer. Not every note needs a conclusion.

quote: If You Are Nothing Without AI, Then You Shouldn't Have It!
